subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should this maintainer-protected PR be closed as superseded by the merged macOS Gateway/Crestodian onboarding work, or should any remaining one-time acknowledgement UX be extracted into a new narrow PR?
rationale: Automation cannot decide whether the old wizard-era acknowledgement and layout ideas still belong after current main replaced the setup flow, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after noting that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 cover the main setup path, and invite a new narrow PR for any remaining current-flow acknowledgement UX.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, remove superseded wizard/setup changes, and keep only a focused, proven current-flow UX change.

options.title: Revive the whole branch
options.body: Require the contributor to fix the security/auth findings, reconcile all current-main overlap, and add real macOS behavior proof before another merge review.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after noting that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935 cover the main setup path, and invite a new narrow PR for any remaining current-flow acknowledgement UX.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged current-main replacements and is the clearest owner for deciding whether this old branch still has product value.
